english.note: This is the all-purpose colloquial choice for an attractive person or a nice-looking thing.
This is the all-purpose colloquial choice for an attractive person or thing, and can also mean visually lovely.
Use this for someone or something that is good-looking, especially in terms of appearance.
This is the all-purpose everyday adjective for a physically attractive person of any gender.
Use this as the all-purpose spoken Cantonese equivalent for someone or something that is gorgeous.
Use this as the all-purpose choice for someone or something that is exceptionally attractive.
Use this as the general choice for someone who is attractive or good-looking, especially when the sexy nuance is not central.
This is the all-purpose colloquial choice for something pleasingly beautiful, including a pretty view or sunset.
Use 靚 when lovely mainly means beautiful or visually attractive.
Use this when “cute” focuses on someone’s attractive appearance, including a sexually attractive person or body part.
Use this when fine means good-looking or attractive, especially of a person.
